copied_files.modification: path routing only: ARCHIVE_DIR (hardcoded old-project-relative archive/) replaced with RAW_DIR resolved from PHM2010_ROOT env var, default <repo>/data/PHM2010/raw. All signal-processing functions (resultant_force, wavelet_denoise, mtf_encode, mtf_to_rgb_image, signal_to_mtf_image) byte-for-byte unchanged.

vendored (no more live 'sys.path.insert + import main_experiment_3_fgds_psi_optimized as dcpsr_base' from the old parent project). split_grouped_lifecycle generalized from hardcoded train={C1,C4}/test={C6} to split_grouped_lifecycle_generic(df, train_cutters, test_cutter), ported from final_statistical_evidence/scripts/methods/condition_split.py::make_split_fn (already-validated generalization for the other 3 raw-signal baselines). fine_state_true / N_FINE_STATES column dropped (only needed by B3/B9's GMM step, unused here). All thresholds/formulas otherwise verbatim.

copied_files.legacy_path: baselines/mtf_avitk/train.py (run_protocol_b's build_model/run_epoch/predict/build_pred_df_subwindow/aggregate_to_run_level only -- Protocol A and the old smoke-test helper were not ported, not needed)
copied_files.modification: seed routing: original hardcoded PROTO_B_CFG['seed']=42 and called its own set_seed() inside run_protocol_b; this version performs NO seeding itself -- shared/utils/seeding.py::seed_everything(self.seed) is called by the adapter base class immediately before build_model(). Also split out of the original's monolithic run_protocol_b() into an adapter (prepare/build_model/train/predict hooks) so the resume/DONE.flag/result-schema logic lives once in shared/runners/method_adapter.py rather than being reimplemented per baseline. Architecture, optimizer (SGD lr=0.0006 wd=2e-4 momentum=0.9), loss (cross-entropy), AMP, grad-checkpoint/grad-accum mechanics unchanged.

storage strategy only: original pre-built ALL 945 runs x 5 sub-windows once into a 2.0GB data/images/*.npy directory (never committed to any git repo, including the old project). This version builds MTF images on-demand per (condition, run_id) via the byte-for-byte-identical preprocessing.py pipeline, cached under data/PHM2010/derived/mtf_avitk_images/ (configurable via MTF_AVITK_IMAGE_CACHE env var) so repeated seeds over the same task skip the wavelet-transform recomputation.

new file: wraps train_core.py/data_prep.py/label_utils.py behind the shared MethodAdapter interface (shared/runners/method_adapter.py). No original logic reimplemented from scratch -- every numeric formula traces to a copied_files entry above.

adaptation_notes: This method's checkpoint (~1.2GB) and per-seed training time (~30-40min on an 8GB laptop GPU) make it the highest-risk method in the 9-method set. This round only vendored code and ran a CPU-only plumbing smoke test -- NO real training was executed by this build task, matching this project's established policy that MTF-AViTK training is run by the user manually or with explicit authorization, never launched unattended. See README.md 'Compute cost' and 'This round's scope' sections.
